label: Fact
headline: Sample live updates: Fictional Veldmark coalition talks enter second day
dek: A sample live blog that tests the {{name}} developing-story template. Veldmark and every party, person and document mentioned are fictional placeholders.
keyPoints: Two fictional Veldmark parties resumed placeholder coalition talks on a second day (sample).
A sample joint statement says no agreement has been reached yet.
A placeholder deadline for forming a government falls at the end of the month (sample).

updates.title: Talks pause for the day
body: Both fictional delegations left the placeholder venue. A sample notice says talks resume tomorrow.

updates.title: Sample joint statement: no agreement yet
body: A sample joint statement from the two fictional parties says they have "made progress" but have not agreed on a budget framework. This is an attributed claim from the parties, not a verified outcome.

updates.title: Placeholder deadline confirmed
body: The fictional Veldmark constitutional office confirmed, in a sample notice, that the placeholder deadline for forming a government is 30 November 2026.

updates.title: Delegations arrive
body: Delegations from both fictional parties arrived at the placeholder venue, according to a sample schedule.

updates.title: Sample live coverage begins
body: This sample live blog follows the second day of fictional coalition talks. Updates appear newest first.

whyItMatters: In this sample, the outcome would decide who governs the fictional state and whether the placeholder budget can pass before its deadline.
confirmed: Talks resumed for a second day (sample schedule).
The placeholder deadline is 30 November 2026 (sample notice).

attributed.attributedTo: the two fictional parties, in a sample joint statement

unknown: Whether an agreement will be reached before the placeholder deadline.
